model.promote: median RMSE >=5%, majority wins, median MAE no worse against corresponding control; exploratory selection, no independent confirmation
model.tie: RMSE difference < 2% keeps the simpler model

feature_definitions.prod_mn: pbr_gas_R × vol_gas_l + pbr_die_R × vol_die_l, R$ millions / day (week mean, month sum)
feature_definitions.prod_pbr_mn: Petrobras mbpd × 1000 × 159 L × PPI deviation, quarter sum
feature_definitions.prod_ind_mn: independent PPI × same ANP national volume
feature_definitions.gap: ind_R − pbr_R (R$/L); not a retail margin
feature_definitions.dqty_mn: change in number of shares traded in millions; total_quantity (not financial cash volume)

protocol.information: contemporaneous / realized exposure on the horizon; no ex-ante forecast

training.windows: trailing validation blocks; expanding train up to the block start

protocol.promotion: median RMSE improvement >=5%, majority of identical blocks and median MAE no worse against the corresponding control (y_only, y_seasonal, or same context without exposure); updated dummy reported separately
protocol.tie: RMSE difference < 2% keeps the simpler model

data_revision.gasoline_22_weeks: Etapa 3 train only; overlaps some Etapa 4 validation blocks; provenance open; dummy equality does not validate fitted models

exclusions: Etapa 3 models not refit; new financial ARIMA/SARIMA/SES/Holt comparison executed separately
quarterly n=4 descriptive; no promotion rule
failure_reasons: PPI×volume below 5% vs y_only (history of the target already captures the series)
gain on median RMSE with a minority of blocks
short horizon (4w / 5d / 1m) often prefers dummy or zero-change
independent sample starts 2022-11-01; older ABICOM layout omits polos
